name: Sonoff SNZB-02D Zigbee Temperature & Humidity Sensor with LCD Display
short_description: Temperature and humidity sensor from Sonoff with Zigbee 3.0 and a large built-in LCD display showing readings clearly. Swiss-made Sensirion sensor for high accuracy with CR2477 battery lasting up to 2 years. Smaller and more accurate than the previous generation.

name: MOES Zigbee Smart Thermostat (BHT-002-GCLZB) - Programmable HVAC Control
short_description: Smart thermostat from MOES with Zigbee 3.0 and LCD touchscreen for home temperature regulation. Supports water/electric underfloor heating and Fan Coil central air conditioning. Weekly programmable scheduling with Tuya and Home Assistant compatibility.

name: Zemismart Zigbee Smart Tubular Motor (ZM25TQ) - Heavy-Duty Roller Blind Motor
short_description: Smart tubular motor from Zemismart with Zigbee 3.0 designed for roller blinds and blackout shades. 1.2Nm torque handles blinds up to 8kg quietly. Direct 100-240V AC power eliminates battery concerns, with full Tuya and Home Assistant compatibility.

name: Aqara Roller Shade Driver E1 (RSD-M01) - Smart Roller Blind Motor with HomeKit
short_description: Smart motor from Aqara for roller shades/blinds using Zigbee 3.0 with full Apple HomeKit compatibility. Supports manual pull control, app control, and voice control. Built-in 6000mAh battery charges via USB-C and lasts up to one year.

name: SwitchBot Bot (S1) - Robotic Finger That Makes Any Button Smart
short_description: Tiny robotic arm from SwitchBot that physically presses any button or switch remotely. Sticks to any surface with 3M adhesive and connects via Bluetooth with timer and scheduling support. The simplest solution to make non-smart devices smart without any wiring.

name: Eve Energy Smart Plug (Matter/Thread) - Next-Gen Smart Plug with Power Monitoring
short_description: Smart plug from Eve with Matter over Thread protocol for reliable connectivity without Wi-Fi dependency. Accurately monitors power consumption with historical usage data. Sleek design supporting Apple HomeKit, Google Home, and Samsung SmartThings via Matter.

name: Aqara Motion Sensor P1 (MS-S02) - Wide-Angle 170° Smart PIR Sensor
short_description: Advanced PIR motion sensor from Aqara with 170-degree detection angle and 7-meter range. Zigbee 3.0 connectivity with 3-level adjustable sensitivity and built-in light sensor. Compatible with Apple HomeKit and all major smart home platforms.

name: Shelly Plus 1PM - Smart Wi-Fi Relay with Power Monitoring
short_description: Compact smart relay from Shelly that fits behind any light switch or appliance. Monitors real-time power consumption with direct Wi-Fi connectivity – no hub required. Ultra-compact form factor (42x36x15mm) with 16A capacity for heavy loads.

name: SwitchBot Curtain 3 (W2400000) - Turn Any Curtain Smart in Minutes
short_description: Smart curtain motor from SwitchBot that converts any existing curtain into a smart curtain without replacing the rail. Bluetooth connectivity with Matter support via SwitchBot Hub. Tool-free installation with battery lasting up to 8 months, with optional solar panel charging.

name: Aqara Hub M2 (HM2-G01) - Multi-Protocol Smart Home Gateway
short_description: Smart home hub from Aqara supporting Zigbee 3.0, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and built-in IR blaster with integrated speaker. Compatible with Apple HomeKit, Google Home, and Amazon Alexa. Serves as the central gateway for all Aqara smart devices.

name: Sonoff TX Ultimate (T5) Smart Wall Switch - Interactive Elegance with RGB
short_description: The next generation of smart switches. Full-surface touch control, haptic feedback, and customizable RGB ambient lighting. Fully compatible with GCC 220V standards.

name: Aqara Water Leak Sensor - Safeguard Your Home from Water Damage
short_description: Small but powerful sensor that detects leaks instantly. Receive mobile notifications and trigger alarms to prevent costly water damage.

name: Broadlink RM4 Pro - Universal Smart Remote for IR & RF Devices
short_description: The ultimate smart remote hub. Control your TV, AC, and motorized curtains from your smartphone. Supports 50,000+ IR and RF devices with voice control compatibility.

name: UniFi Protect G4 Pro Camera - 4K Ultra HD Surveillance Excellence
short_description: The pinnacle of UniFi surveillance. 4K resolution, 3x optical zoom, and superior IR night vision in a weatherproof IP67 housing. Uncompromising detail for maximum security.

name: Aqara Smart Door Lock A100 - Elite Security with Apple HomeKey Support
short_description: Premium smart lock featuring 9 unlocking methods, including Fingerprint and Apple HomeKey. 18-month battery life and seamless integration with HomeKit, Google, and Alexa.
